Description
solvers.linearSystem.btf.topLevelBlocks
Top level blocks of the Block Triangular Form linear system decomposition used by the JMVA MoM and CoMoM solvers.

    This class implements the Carry Forward Equations of the linear system The Factory Methods newMacroBlock and subBlockCopy are implemented to return the correct block type in the parallel hierarchy.
